verdict.rationale: Published board power and cooling guidance are a fair axis for any GPU, including a data-center SXM module, so the story applies. However, the evidence never states a TDP figure, connector or power-delivery requirements, or cooling guidance for the H200 SXM. It only says the card has the 'same power profile as the H100' (no number), and the air-cooled note refers to the separate H200 NVL SKU, so neither delivers this story.
